# chas-elite-prep-mcp

> CHAS / SafeContractor / Constructionline pre-qualification preparation. Health & safety, environmental, equality, financial assessment.

MCP server by MEOK AI Labs. Framework: fastmcp. Transport: stdio.

## Tools
- chas_readiness_check
- list_chas_requirements
- h_and_s_policy_audit
- sssip_mutual_recognition
- supplier_pq_template

## Install
```
pip install chas-elite-prep-mcp
```

## Links
- PyPI: https://pypi.org/project/chas-elite-prep-mcp/
- Docs: https://meok.ai
